title: Mood signal — logistic regression against the personal baseline
learning: Supervised (binary classification, logistic regression). Target: episode established on that day (injected, hence known). Split by astronaut.
data: SIMULATED cohort of 1500 virtual astronauts × 151 days, 40% with an episode (random onset and intensity), isolated bad spells as decoys.
limits: SIMULATED data: shows the method works on episodes we defined, not on real astronauts.
A signal to look at, never a diagnosis: it PROPOSES a psych session and imposes nothing (§11).
Compares the astronaut with themselves (baseline D0–D20), never with a population norm.
